pages.text: Bathes a chicken in reagents to create something new.

pages.title: Inputs
pages.text: The machine needs three things at once:$(br)$(li)An eligible $(l)chicken$()$(li)Stored $(l)item$(), $(l)fluid$() or $(l)chemical$() reagents$(li)$(l)RF$()$(br2)The result is a specialized chicken spawn egg.

pages.title: Dragon and Wither
pages.text: Two infusion paths stand apart from the rest: the $(l)Dragon$() and $(l)Wither$() recipes. Both demand endgame reagents and both unlock breeds you cannot obtain any other way.
